Author's Note: Yesterday, crypto reminded the world of its immaturity, with the crash of a $6 billion (top 20) market cap coin Mantra (OM), which fell from $6 to $0.70 on Sunday. The buzz all around crypto right now is this event, as everyone is shocked to see the supposedly legitimate Mantra — an L1 chain for tokenizing RWAs, which received partnerships with large real estate developers in Dubai who agreed to tokenize billions on its chain — ultimately get rugged. Though we did not have an official position on this coin, our Digital Assets Team was acutely aware of the mounting concerns around this coin, being one of the most overhyped this cycle, and flagged it in November as well as just days before the crash on X/Twitter. The downwards momentum and chaos will no doubt further weigh on the space amidst current Quad 4 conditions, not to mention the nascent RWA subsector.
